item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and partially staffs an internal investigatory board; this is executive organization rather than a change to legal rights.","evidence":"I hereby create a Board of Inquiry"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The segment appoints a board member, assigns an investigative task, and incorporates the board's statutory powers and duties; these are internal staffing and authority assignments, not a dictated legal outcome.","evidence":"whom I appoint to inquire into the issues involved in this dispute"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Board must submit a report by a deadline and remain available for statutory functions; the required actions are reporting and administrative continuity, with no substantive legal consequence imposed by this segment.","evidence":"The Board shall report to the President"}]}
